intro: Curated tools, platforms, and references that cover core neuroscience workflows from data collection to analysis and sharing.

categories.label: Analysis and signal processing
categories.description: Primary toolkits for preprocessing, cleaning, and interpreting neural signals.

resources.name: MNE-Python
resources.summary: End-to-end Python toolbox for MEG, EEG, and iEEG preprocessing, analysis, and visualization.

resources.name: EEGLAB
resources.summary: MATLAB environment for EEG preprocessing, ICA workflows, and event-related analyses.

resources.name: FieldTrip
resources.summary: Open-source MATLAB toolbox for advanced EEG/MEG analysis and source localization.

categories.label: Neuroimaging and MRI
categories.description: Widely used suites for structural and functional MRI pipelines.

resources.name: FSL
resources.summary: Comprehensive suite for MRI preprocessing, registration, and statistical modeling.

resources.name: SPM12
resources.summary: MATLAB-based toolbox for statistical analysis of fMRI, PET, and EEG/MEG imaging data.

resources.name: FreeSurfer
resources.summary: Automated cortical surface reconstruction and structural MRI analysis toolkit.

resources.name: Nilearn
resources.summary: Python library for statistical learning, visualization, and decoding on neuroimaging data.

categories.label: BCI and real-time systems
categories.description: Platforms for online signal processing and closed-loop experiments.

resources.name: OpenViBE
resources.summary: Real-time BCI platform for signal acquisition, processing pipelines, and feedback control.

resources.name: BCI2000
resources.summary: Complete BCI system for acquisition, signal processing, stimulus presentation, and feedback.

resources.name: OpenBCI
resources.summary: Open-source biosensing hardware and software ecosystem for research and prototyping.

categories.label: Data standards and sharing
categories.description: Best practices for organizing, publishing, and reusing neuroscience data.

resources.name: BIDS
resources.summary: Community standard for organizing and describing neuroimaging datasets.

resources.name: DANDI Archive
resources.summary: Archive for neurophysiology data with rich metadata and dataset tooling.

resources.name: OpenNeuro
resources.summary: Repository for BIDS datasets with public sharing and versioning support.

categories.label: Learning and references
categories.description: Foundational references for neuroscience concepts and vocabulary.

resources.name: Neuroscience Online
resources.summary: Free online textbook covering core neuroscience topics and terminology.

resources.name: Allen Brain Atlas
resources.summary: Interactive brain anatomy and gene expression reference for research.

resources.name: BrainFacts
resources.summary: Clear explanations of key neuroscience concepts and discoveries.
